row.title_or_caption: Maryland Phoebe Davis funeral program, order of service and obituary (Watson Funeral Home, February 1, 2020)
row.transcription: Order of service and obituary, funeral program of Maryland Phoebe Davis (Watson Funeral Home, February 1, 2020). Obituary: born in Millsboro, Delaware on June 30, 1939 to the late William Wesley Davis and Phoebe (Thompson) Davis; preceded in death by her companion of 37 years Charles Henry; educated at Millsboro #204 School and William C. Jason High School; employed at Townsend Poultry Plant for over 30 years; helped raise her sister Joan's children Sandra Davis, Jane Davis, and Toney Floyd. Interment: Harmony U.M. Cemetery, 28571 Harmony Cemetery Rd, Millsboro, DE 19966. The small photograph beside the obituary shows her with an unidentified man (the couch photograph; the man is not Charles Henry, per Jequan Davis's ruling of 2026-11-23). Program photographed and supplied by Jequan Davis, 2026-11-20.

new_facts.evidence: Funeral program of Maryland Phoebe Davis (Watson Funeral Home, 2020), obituary: 'Aunt Meryl, as she was affectionately called by everyone in the community.'

Statement of Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23: Marilyn Davis ('Merle') and Maryland Phoebe Davis ('Aunt Meryl') are the same person; 'Marilyn' is the name form he knew her by. Any future import for a 'Marilyn Davis' of this family belongs on this profile, never a new one.

notes_append.text: [Funeral program, Watson Funeral Home, 2020] Per her funeral program: she never had biological children; she helped raise her sister Joan's children Sandra Davis, Jane Davis, and Toney Floyd, all of Millsboro. Survivors at her death: brothers William Davis Jr., Stanley Davis (Millsboro), and Preston Davis (Seaford), and her sister Joan Davis.
